story_title: As an Event Coordinator, I want to search and filter venues using event requirements so that I can identify suitable options for the event.

acceptance_criteria.text: The Event Coordinator can filter by date and time.
The Event Coordinator can filter by expected attendance/capacity.
The Event Coordinator can filter by location.
The Event Coordinator can filter by accessibility requirements.
The Event Coordinator can filter by room layout.
The Event Coordinator can filter by required facilities.
Results only display venues matching the selected criteria.

test_cases.title: Find a venue opens from the Venues page and lists every active venue when no filter is set
test_cases.preconditions:
Seed data freshly loaded (npx prisma db seed): 16 active venues.
Logged in as Coordinator Daniel Tan (daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123).
steps: Look at the results count above the list
test_cases.test_data: No filters set
test_cases.expected_result:
The 'Find a venue' page opens with the subtitle 'Only venues matching every filter you set are shown.'
All filters are empty ('Any building', 'Any layout', no boxes ticked).
The count reads '16 of 16 venues match' and 16 venue cards are listed, from Changi Conference Centre (CBP-CONF) to Orchard Studio (ORC-STU).

test_cases.title: Filter by expected attendance compares with the chosen layout's capacity, not the venue maximum
test_cases.preconditions:

Room layout: (any), then Classroom
test_cases.expected_result:

test_cases.title: Opening Find a venue from an event fills every filter from the event's requirements
test_cases.preconditions:
Logged in as Daniel Tan (daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123), coordinator of 'Straits Medical Research Symposium' (EVT-000004, status Planning).
The symposium expects 200 people, theatre layout, 09:00-18:00 on its date; mandatory requirements: High-density WiFi, Video conferencing suite, Livestream capability, Hearing induction loop, Wheelchair spaces; Catering pantry is a nice-to-have.
steps: Open 'Straits Medical Research Symposium' from Events
test_cases.test_data: Event: EVT-000004
test_cases.expected_result:
The Find a venue page opens with the breadcrumb 'Events / EVT-000004 / Find a venue' and the subtitle 'Filled in from Straits Medical Research Symposium's requirements...'.
From/To show the event's date 09:00 and 18:00; Expected attendance 200; Room layout Theatre; Location 'Any building'.
Wheelchair spaces and Hearing induction loop are ticked under Accessibility requirements; High-density WiFi, Video conferencing suite and Livestream capability are ticked under Required facilities; Catering pantry is NOT ticked.
The results are already shown: Marina Auditorium (MAR-AUD), Changi Conference Centre (CBP-CONF), Marina Grand Hall (MAR-GH), each with a 'Check suitability' button.

test_cases.title: An Event Organiser cannot use venue search
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as Event Organiser Evelyn Chen (look up her email in npx prisma studio > users; password123), organiser of 'Straits Medical Research Symposium'.
steps: Check the sidebar for a 'Venues' link
Type /venues/search into the address bar and press Enter
test_cases.test_data: Page: /venues/search
test_cases.expected_result:
There is no 'Venues' link in the organiser's sidebar.
The page shows the error 'Not available - Venue search is for ConnectSphere staff.' and no venue is listed.

open_questions: Approved -> Planning: the status lifecycle diagram labels this move 'search', and the seed's status history reason for Planning is 'Venue search started'. SPM-40 does NOT change the event's status - searching is read-only, and an event would flip to Planning just because someone looked. Nothing else moves Approved -> Planning yet either. Should the move happen when the coordinator submits the first venue booking request (SPM-42), or when they first open Find a venue for the event?

Tentative holds (#41): a venue with a PENDING booking request for another event at an overlapping time is hidden from results, because the customer allows only one active hold per venue and time, so asking for it would only be refused. SPM-46's availability calendar shows the same hold as a warning rather than a block. Confirm hiding it is right for search.

Opening hours: a venue is matched only when the search starts at or after its opening time and ends at or before its closing time (checked on the first and last day of a multi-day search, not overnight). The AC says 'date and time' only; this is the team's reading of #46 (Venue Staff maintain operating hours). Confirm.

Setup and turnaround: under the customer's slot rules (#50, #107, #108, #123, implemented by SPM-46's venueSlots.ts) the searched event's OWN setup and turnaround slots must be free too, so e.g. an AM search hides a venue whose previous-night slot is another booking's turnaround. This makes the search stricter than 'is anything booked during my hours'. Confirm this is wanted.
Attendance with no layout chosen matches a venue if ANY of its layouts seats that many; a venue with no layouts never matches an attendance filter. Venue.maxCapacity is never used (#112). Confirm.

Pre-filling from an event ticks only its MANDATORY facility and accessibility requirements; nice-to-haves are left unticked so they don't hide venues (AC7 would drop any venue lacking one). Location is left as 'Any building' because an event has no location requirement. Confirm both.

Mockup vs AC7: design/mockups/VenueSearch.dc.html shows over-capacity, partial-match and unavailable venues greyed out in the list. AC7 says results show ONLY matching venues, so SPM-40 hides them; the greyed 'not suitable, and why' view is SPM-41's Venue tab. The mockup should be updated or the team should confirm the split.

No 'Request' button: the mockup's Request / Request anyway buttons belong to S-15 Venue booking request (SPM-42), not built. SPM-40 offers 'Check suitability' (SPM-41) from an event's results instead.

Dates in these test cases depend on the day the seed was run - seed dates are relative to 'today'. Absolute dates given assume seeding on 28 Sep 2026; recompute from the event dates shown in the app otherwise.

Found while testing, outside SPM-40: on main, the SPM-41 Venue tab (/events/EVT-000004/venue) always says the event does not exist, because GET /api/events/[id]/venue-suitability looks the event up by its internal id while every link now uses the EVT- reference (SPM-31). TC19 reaches Find a venue through that tab's 'Search with filters' button, which still works because the button renders even when the tab's own check fails. The SPM-41 owner should switch that route to parseEventReference().
